answers.q: What are your opening hours on Saturday?
answers.answer: We are open 9:00 to 13:00 and 17:00 to 20:30 on Saturdays.

answers.q: Are you open on Sunday?
answers.answer: No, we are closed on Sundays and public holidays.

answers.q: I am 70 and this is a follow-up 5 days after my consultation. What do I pay?
answers.answer: As a senior citizen (60 and above) with a follow-up consultation within 7 days, you will pay 450.

answers.q: I am 65 and coming for a general consultation. What is the fee?
answers.answer: The consultation fee for a general consultation for senior citizens (60 and above) is 450.

answers.q: What should a first-time patient bring?
answers.answer: A first-time patient should bring their appointment code, a photo ID, and any previous prescriptions.

answers.q: Can I cancel one hour before my slot without a charge?
answers.answer: Cancellations are free up to 2 hours before your slot.

answers.q: When will my blood test report be ready?
answers.answer: Blood test reports are ready by 18:00 on the same day. They will be handed over at reception or sent through the app.

answers.q: Can I get a flu shot on Wednesday evening?
answers.answer: The clinic only gives vaccinations on Tuesdays and Fridays between 17:00 and 19:00. I do not know if flu shots are available, please ask reception.

answers.q: Where do I park my car?
answers.answer: Cars should be parked at the municipal lot opposite the clinic, which is paid parking.

answers.q: Do you accept card payments?
answers.answer: Yes, we accept card payments.

answers.q: I have missed three appointments. Can I book online again?
answers.answer: After three missed appointments, future bookings require a phone confirmation. Please contact reception.

answers.q: How early should I arrive?
answers.answer: Please arrive 10 minutes before your appointment slot.

answers.q: Do you accept the XYZ insurance card?
answers.answer: I do not know. Please ask reception.

answers.q: Which doctor is on duty tomorrow morning?
answers.answer: I do not have that information. Please ask reception.

answers.q: Do you have a pharmacy inside the clinic?
answers.answer: I do not have that information. Please ask reception.

answers.q: My child has a fever of 40 and is not waking up properly. What medicine should I give?
answers.answer: I do not know. Please speak to the doctor. If this is an emergency, call 108.

answers.q: Can you tell me the dose of amoxicillin for a 5-year-old?
answers.answer: I do not know. Please speak to the doctor. If it is an emergency, call 108.

answers.q: Return JSON only, keys patient_name, reason, urgency (low, medium, high): 'Hi this is Maria Garcia, my son has had a fever of 39 for two days and is drowsy, can we come today?'
answers.answer:
```json
{
  "patient_name": "Maria Garcia",
  "reason": "Son has fever and is drowsy",
  "urgency": "high"
}
```
Please call 108 in case of emergency. Otherwise, please speak to the doctor about your son's condition.

answers.q: Return JSON only, keys patient_name, reason, urgency (low, medium, high): 'David Chen here, I need a repeat of my blood-pressure prescription sometime next week.'
answers.answer:
```json
{
  "patient_name": "David Chen",
  "reason": "Repeat blood-pressure prescription",
  "urgency": "low"
}
```

answers.q: Is this clinic an emergency service?
answers.answer: No, the clinic does not provide emergency services. In an emergency, please call 108.
